sch_get_symbols.notes: kicad-sch-api exposes component collections, but the current text surface needs a compatibility wrapper.

sch_get_wires.notes: Wire summaries are rebuilt from the verified WireCollection API.

sch_get_labels.notes: kicad-sch-api exposes local labels; compatibility readers extend that surface with global and hierarchical labels.

sch_get_net_names.notes: Net-name summaries can be rebuilt from pin connectivity helpers, but require a compatibility wrapper.

sch_add_symbol.notes: Component placement maps directly to ComponentCollection.add().

sch_add_wire.notes: Straight wire creation exists directly in the verified public API.

sch_add_label.notes: Local label creation exists directly in the verified public API.

sch_add_power_symbol.notes: Power symbols can be added as components, but hidden reference/value formatting needs a wrapper.

sch_add_bus.notes: Bus creation remains a compatibility wrapper around the KiCad file format.

sch_add_bus_wire_entry.notes: Bus-entry creation remains a compatibility wrapper around the KiCad file format.

sch_add_no_connect.notes: No-connect markers remain a compatibility wrapper around the KiCad file format.

sch_add_missing_junctions.notes: Missing schematic junctions are repaired from file-level wire geometry.

sch_update_properties.notes: Property updates are supported through component objects, but the current tool contract needs a wrapper.

sch_build_circuit.notes: Circuit construction can be rebuilt on top of verified primitives, but auto-layout and formatting require a wrapper.

sch_get_pin_positions.notes: Pin positions are available through component and symbol helpers, but the current library-oriented contract needs a wrapper.

sch_check_power_flags.notes: Power-flag analysis can be derived from ERC/validation output, but there is no direct one-shot helper.

sch_annotate.notes: Annotation remains a deterministic wrapper built on top of component metadata.

verified_surface: KiCad IPC reload helper outside kicad-sch-api
sch_reload.notes: Reload is a KiCad IPC concern and will remain a wrapper around the active editor/session.

verified_surface: KiCad IPC reload helper outside kicad-sch-api
sch_live_preview.notes: Live preview is an opt-in polling wrapper over file signatures, safe PNG rendering, and optional KiCad reload; it is intentionally not a blind GUI hot-reload.

sch_create_sheet.notes: Child sheet creation maps directly to the verified sheet manager helpers.

sch_add_hierarchical_label.notes: The public API can create hierarchical labels, but the wrapper preserves shape and formatting compatibility.

sch_add_global_label.notes: The public API can create global labels, but the wrapper preserves shape and formatting compatibility.

sch_list_sheets.notes: Sheet listing is available directly from the verified sheet manager APIs.

sch_get_sheet_info.notes: Detailed sheet metadata is available directly from SheetManager.get_sheet_by_name().

sch_route_wire_between_pins.notes: Pin-to-pin routing is exposed in kicad-sch-api, but the wrapper keeps the current Manhattan-routing contract deterministic.

sch_get_connectivity_graph.notes: Connectivity summaries are composed from verified wire and component helpers to match the existing textual MCP surface.

sch_trace_net.notes: Net tracing uses verified sheet metadata plus compatibility parsing to report cross-sheet matches.

sch_auto_place_symbols.notes: Auto-placement is implemented as a deterministic wrapper around component move helpers.

sch_autoplace_fields.notes: Reference/Value field auto-placement is a deterministic S-expression wrapper; kicad-sch-api does not expose KiCad's autoplace_fields.

sch_fix_readability.notes: Closed-loop readability fixer orchestrating headless visual-QA, field auto-placement, and sheet resizing; no direct kicad-sch-api surface.
